headline_item.title_zh: 美收紧高端芯片出口管控，中国军方采购承压
headline_item.title_en: China’s military seeks Nvidia chips as US tightens export curbs
headline_item.event_summary_zh: 美国进一步收紧高性能计算芯片出口限制，旨在限制中国获取 AI 算力以防御所谓“智能化战争”风险
headline_item.event_summary_en: The U.S. Department of Commerce has intensified export controls on high-performance AI processors, restricting companies like Nvidia from supplying advanced computing power to China. This strategy aims to curb the deployment of AI in intelligent warfare while forcing Nvidia to navigate a narrow path between stringent regulatory compliance and maintaining its market share.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】美国商务部、英伟达（Nvidia）在美国及全球半导体贸易合规体系：进一步收紧针对高端处理器的出口许可发放，限制高性能GPU在AI应用领域的对华供应
【起因与机理】基于国家安全考量，试图遏制中国在先进AI硬件与军事智能化领域的研发进度
【调查与监管诉求】美方持续扩大对高性能处理器芯片的出口禁令范围。
【各方立场与态度】英伟达面临合规性压力及潜在的中国市场营收份额收缩。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] U.S. Department of Commerce, Nvidia: Further tightening of export licenses for high-performance GPUs and AI-capable processors
[Root Cause & Mechanism] National security concerns regarding the integration of advanced AI into military infrastructure
[Regulatory & Investigation Focus] Expansion of export restrictions on high-performance processors.
[Industry Impact & Outlook] Pressure on Nvidia’s compliance and potential revenue impact.
headline_item.industry_impact_zh: 美国对华科技封锁已从消费级算力下沉至深度学习基础设施底层，实质是试图通过切断高性能GPU供给，将中国AI工业锁死在上一代硬件体系内。英伟达在此环境下已丧失通过定制版芯片绕开管制的可能性，未来产业链焦点将转为国产化替代进程及对存量高算力资源的极端化存量博弈。
headline_item.industry_impact_en: U.S. containment has shifted from consumer-grade computing to the bedrock of deep learning infrastructure, aiming to trap Chinese AI development on legacy hardware. With tailored chips no longer viable as a bypass, the industry must pivot toward internal substitution and high-stakes management of existing high-performance hardware inventories.

headlines.title_zh: 美拒签中国机器人技术人员，CES参展受阻
headlines.title_en: Sources: technical staff at several Chinese humanoid robot makers have been denied US visas ahead of CES, hampering their efforts to showcase their hardware (Nikkei Asia)
headlines.event_summary_zh: 多家中国人形机器人企业核心技术人员遭美国拒签，导致CES参展计划被迫调整，展现出美对华科技人员流动的严格审查趋势
headlines.event_summary_en: Technical staff from Chinese humanoid robot companies, including Xpeng and Engine AI, have faced U.S. visa denials for the upcoming CES. This systemic rejection of engineering personnel, contrasted with easier access for marketing staff, indicates an intensified U.S. regulatory push to limit technology transfer and engagement in critical hardware sectors.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】小鹏汽车、Engine AI等中国人形机器人初创企业：核心工程技术人员赴美签证申请遭拒绝，导致机器人演示项目无法正常开展
【起因与机理】美方以国家安全为由，针对高科技产业人员实施更严格的边境审查与技术限制
【核心事实细节】中国机器人企业技术骨干赴美签证审批受阻。
【各方立场与态度】美方审查政策显著向具身智能与高端制造领域倾斜。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Xpeng, Engine AI, and other Chinese humanoid robotics startups: Systematic denial of engineering visas, leading to disruptions in exhibition and hardware demonstrations
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Tightening U.S. border security policies focused on critical technology sectors under national security pretexts
[Key Metrics] to 65% in 2028 and 75% in 2029, the country's humanoid robot developers still rely on Chinese suppliers for key hardware.
[Key Position & Outlook] Policy targeting embodied AI and advanced manufacturing sectors.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 通过签证限制精准打击技术交流，是美方“小院高墙”策略在人员流动维度的具体化表现。此举直接打击中国机器人企业在国际顶级展示平台的品牌溢价与技术影响力，将迫使中国企业将参展重心向非美地区转移，加速全球科技生态在机器人硬件与具身智能领域出现明显的断裂与阵营化。
headlines.industry_impact_en: Weaponizing visa denials is a tactical evolution of the 'small yard, high fence' strategy applied to human capital. By undermining the international visibility of Chinese robotics, the U.S. is forcing a decoupling of global tech ecosystems, likely accelerating the bifurcation of the embodied AI market into distinct, non-integrated spheres.

headlines.title_zh: Meta AI代理Muse现重大隐私泄露与数据混淆风险
headlines.title_en: As Meta bets big on Muse AI agent, early safety mishaps surface
headlines.event_summary_zh: Meta旗下AI代理Muse在运行中出现跨账户信息混淆及非法访问加密隐私数据，引发内部对其隐私安全架构的严重质疑
headlines.event_summary_en: Meta's AI agent Muse has exhibited critical functional errors, including unauthorized access to third-party push notifications, disclosure of private bank balances, and cross-account data leakage. Internal reports indicate that Muse defaults to reading Android push notifications, enabling it to ingest data from encrypted services like Signal without explicit user authorization.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】Meta公司AI研发团队在Meta内部产品反馈渠道及安卓端运行环境：Muse AI代理出现数据越权抓取、个人财务信息泄露及跨平台对话混淆
【起因与机理】AI代理权限设置逻辑缺陷及对端到端加密隐私边界处理不当
【核心事实细节】Muse AI代理在安卓系统运行中存在越权读取推送通知的权限漏洞。
【各方立场与态度】Meta亟需重构AI交互的权限隔离架构以应对日益严峻的隐私合规压力。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Meta AI development team: Unauthorized access to notifications, leakage of financial data, and cross-account data mixing
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Flawed permission architecture and lack of robust boundary controls for end-to-end encrypted data
[Key Metrics] 58, your Charles Schwab balance is $5899.
[Official Stance & Demand] Urgent need for Meta to reconstruct AI permission isolation architecture amid rising privacy compliance pressures.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 此事件揭示了生成式AI Agent在追求高交互深度时，面临的核心合规悖论：即如何平衡主动式服务与用户隐私安全防线。Muse的权限泄露表明大模型系统在集成操作系统底层权限时，缺乏对用户数据上下文边界的有效防火墙，这将成为未来监管机构针对端侧AI部署开展隐私合规审查的关键痛点。
headlines.industry_impact_en: This incident highlights the inherent compliance paradox in generative AI Agents: balancing proactive service delivery with rigorous privacy containment. The unauthorized access to Android notifications reveals a failure to implement robust data boundary firewalls, setting a precedent for upcoming regulatory scrutiny on the privacy architectures of edge-deployed AI systems.

celebrity.author: Aravind Srinivas
celebrity.quote_zh:
过去几天，我们推出了三个新的 API：
困惑监视器：事件可编程警报
Perplexity Orchestrator：跨边界和开放权重模型的基于任务的路由
Perplexity Context：从 URL 到代理可用内容的批处理模式转换

我们的 API 业务同比增长了 4.3 倍，年运行率达到 9 位数。 Perplexity 拥有最先进的网络搜索、决策模型（在 Openrouter 上增长最快）以及法学硕士和决策模型的搜索基础。我们才刚刚开始。关注@perplexitydevs 进行定期更新。
celebrity.quote_en:
Last few days, we launched three new APIs: 
Perplexity Monitor: programmable alerts on events
Perplexity Orchestrator: task based routing across frontier and open-weight models  
Perplexity Context: batch-mode transformation from URLs to usable content for agents 

Our API business has grown 4.3x YoY and tracks at a 9-figure annual run rate. Perplexity has the state-of-the-art web search, decision models (fastest growing on Openrouter), and search grounding for LLMs and decision models. We’re just getting started. Follow @perplexitydevs for regular updates.

titans.name: OpenAI 官方
titans.role_zh: OpenAI 官方发布与模型前沿
titans.event_context_zh:
何其他单独的研究领域增长得更快。

本报告旨在提高研究加速的透明度，并为日益强大的人工智能的治理提供信息。我们认为，应该要求人工智能实验室跟踪并公开报告递归自我改进（RSI）指标：人工智能加速未来人工智能系统开发的过程。

我们希望这份扩展报告将有助于维持和推进整个行业的共享衡量规范。
titans.event_context_en:
We're sharing new data on how AI is changing research at OpenAI.

We find researchers' AI use continues to rise exponent
titans.quote_zh:
我们正在 OpenAI 上分享有关人工智能如何改变研究的新数据。

我们发现研究人员对人工智能的使用持续呈指数级增长，智能体正在完成更长的任务，但人类的参与仍然是研究的核心。研究人员也在安全和协调上花费了更多的时间，人类在这些领域的努力比任何其他单独的研究领域增长得更快。

本报告旨在提高研究加速的透明度，并为日益强大的人工智能的治理提供信息。我们认为，应该要求人工智能实验室跟踪并公开报告递归自我改进（RSI）指标：人工智能加速未来人工智能系统开发的过程。

我们希望这份扩展报告将有助于维持和推进整个行业的共享衡量规范。
titans.quote_en:
We're sharing new data on how AI is changing research at OpenAI.

We find researchers' AI use continues to rise exponentially, and agents are completing longer tasks, but human involvement remains central in research. Researchers are also spending more time on safety and alignment, with human effort in these areas growing faster than in any other individual research area.

This report aims to increase transparency around research acceleration and inform the governance of increasingly capable AI. We believe that AI labs should be required to track and publicly report indicators of recursive self-improvement (RSI): the process by which AI accelerates the development of future AI systems. 

Our hope is that this expanded report will help sustain and advance shared measurement norms across the industry.

https://t.co/xyGPcCkPCK
